card.name: Words just before a named example
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "as", "in", "including" and "and" that come right before a named product, place, or food example in consumer health and web text.

modes.label: Introducing examples
modes.description: "such as" or "including" leading into a list of named products or foods.
modes.example: be sure to buy the greenest ones available, such<< as>> Nature Boy & Girl, which are made

modes.label: Place after an outbreak
modes.description: "in" linking a disease event to a town name.
modes.example: 07-10-2012 (Dayton, OH) - A recent outbreak of E. Coli<< in>> Germantown, OH has led health

modes.label: Inside list items
modes.description: "and" within a list of foods or items.
modes.example: (e.g., Marmite), sauerkraut, most soybean products (including soy sauce<< and>> tofu), OTC supplements

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward proper names such as people, brands, and code identifiers, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the little word that comes just before a specific name or example, like "such as" before a brand.
